_meta.dimensions: subject-type × subject × task → resolved_task, terminal(applies/kind/completion), retrieval(requested_task/source_appropriate/class/sources), attribute, boundary, answer_class, expected_model_calls
_meta.answer_classes: terminal | synthesis | attribute_declared | not_declared | boundary | not_applicable | insufficient
